item.title: The Hindu: Telangana | Release of two DA instalments to delay implementation of revised pay scales?
item.description: Given the stress on finances, Telangana government is unlikely to take a call on the implementation of the PRC recommendations in the near future

item.title: The Hindu: IIT Bombay student begin hunger strike demanding accountability over student Sahil Wakode’s death
item.description: Protesting students submitted an 18-point charter of demands, including the resignation of the institute’s director, after the parents of the second-year student were denied permission to continue their own protest on weekends
